verses.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.sm: Atua, o lo tatou malu ia ma lo tatou malosi;

verses.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.sm: e fai o ia ma fesoasoani silisili i puapuaga. Io O le mea lea tatou te le fefefe ai, pe a faaliliuina le lalolagi, ma luluina mauga i totonu o le sami;

verses.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.sm: pe a taalili ma sousou ona suásami, ma faagateteina ai mauga i lona maualuga. Selā.

verses.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.sm: O le vaitafe, e faafiafia ona magavai i le aai a le Atua, o le mea paia, o i ai afioaga o le Silisili ese. O loo i totonu ia te ia le Atua,

verses.en: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.sm: e le faagaeetia lava ia, e fesoasoani le Atua ia te, ia i le vave ao. Ua váváó nuu ese, ua faagaeetia malo;

verses.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.sm: ua túlei mai lona siufofoga, ona liu suávai lea o le lalolagi.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.sm: Ua ia te i tatou le ALII o ‘au; o le Atua o Iakopo d lo tatou ‘olo máualuga ia. Sela.

verses.en: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.sm: Ina o mai ia, ina vaavaai i galuega a le ALII, o le ua faja faatafunaga i le lalolagi.

verses.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.sm: Ua faajua e ia o taua e oo lava i tulu'iga o le lalolagi; ua gagau e ia le aufana, ma vavae le tao; ua susunuina foi e ia kariota i le afi.

verses.en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.sm: Ina soia, ma ia outou iloa o aʻu lava o le Atua; e viia a‘u i nuu ese, e viia a‘u i le lalolagi.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.sm: Ua ia te i tatou le ALII o ‘au, o le Atua o Iakopo, o lo tatou ‘olo maualuga ia. Sela.
